title: Gold frames: walk SE contact + passing, hand-authored to the design lock
question: What does 'done' look like for walk SE? These are two hand-polished frames (contact L, passing L) that follow DESIGN_LOCK.md exactly, for the owner to approve as the target the pipeline is tuned to.
method: Authored by hand in REVIEW/exp/2026-10-30_sw_walk_se/gold/build_gold.py. Large masses are polygons with hand-picked vertices; legs and boots are pixel spans with uniform 1:2 slopes. The bow and bun are a char block (bow_block.txt); hands, cuffs and skirt corners are char-block repaints. Line rules: closed 1-px K silhouette, interior K only at the listed overlaps, pixel-perfect clean-up. Flat 2-tone shading plus one hair sheen. facesys 'open' eyes and brows at the SE layout. Poses follow walk.json keys 0 and 2 and the round-10 SE strip. Gates: lamet.py metrics plus a palette check (gates.py). One Opus critique, with its fixes applied.
result: Both frames pass every gate: zigzags 0, redundant L-corners 0, outline gaps 0, line-art 2x2 K clumps 0, unlisted interior K 0, one connected piece, 12 colours (K h H g L s S E R O o W), none off-palette. The 5 raw K clumps per frame are inside the exact facesys eye templates (reported separately). Opus round 1 scored line 7, consistency 6, appeal 6 and anatomy 6, before the fixes. Applied fixes: wider V stride on contact, bent passing knee with the foot tucked, asymmetric arms, stronger SE head and body turn, hem raised 2 px, bow redrawn (no mouse ears) with a 1:2 tail, sheen arc, clean mitten hands.
verdict: Needs the owner's review. Open questions: approve as gold or mark up pixels; accept the eye-template clumps; jaw/shoulder bob (illustration) or the master's longer wavy side locks.
